title: Covestro uses AVEVA PI System to achieve sustainable growth
summary: The Covestro Monitoring Platform on PI System unifies more than one million real-time data streams and contextualises thousands of critical assets. AI anomaly detection comes from AVEVA Predictive Analytics.
challenge: Covestro needed to standardise and share energy and production data. Overlooked notifications and unplanned shutdowns caused significant losses.
solution: PI System as the data platform, combined with AI anomaly detection.

outcomes.text: CO2 emissions reduced by 39% per ton of product, on track for a 50% reduction by 2030

title: Driving manufacturing excellence at dsm-firmenich with AI and standardized PI Server data
summary: dsm-firmenich built a global Operations Data Layer (ODL) on PI Server and AF, uses OEE as its day-to-day KPI and added an AI copilot for troubleshooting and onboarding.
challenge: Manual reports and contextualisation across a global network.
solution: A standardised ODL on PI Server and AF, with PI data contextualised in Shiftconnector.

outcomes.text: The ODL supports 3,500 users (no other figures)
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Jens Tuexen) in an AVEVA World 2024 abstract

verifyNote: Source is a presentation abstract only; details were not confirmed from the full deck.

title: Structuring manufacturing data at scale
summary: Syensqo uses a central-to-local model: central data managers create standard AF templates and hierarchies, and local teams build solutions on them, across about 30 polymer plants. The transformation began in 2016.
challenge: Syensqo wanted to replicate solutions between sites without removing site autonomy.
solution: Central AF templates and hierarchies with local solutions, feeding Seeq and Ekhosoft.

outcomes.text: OEE rollout from 26 weeks to 5 weeks; batch watcher from 11 weeks to 4 weeks

title: Digital transformation of agribusiness operations using PI System and Unified Operations Center
summary: Nutrien combines PI System data with AVEVA Unified Operations Center in a central monitoring centre for nitrogen production.
challenge: Nutrien needed to integrate site data so engineering and operations could collaborate.
solution: PI data shown in AVEVA Unified Operations Center.
